newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets see routine price-testing.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets see routine price-testing.

text.p: European raw cotton trade saw little more than routine price testing enquiry due to a lack of fresh stimulus, industry sources said.
Having given continental trade a boost on Thursday by reacting to speculation over higher US production forecasts, the New York futures market settled again.
Buying interest in Europe continued to centre on Central Asian types and the 'A' Index ended unchanged at 75.20.
